tours.name: Lalibela Rock-Hewn Churches
tours.description: Fly north to the rock-hewn wonders of Lalibela — churches carved straight into the mountain, with a local guide and all transfers included.

tours.name: Simien Mountains Trek
tours.description: Epic Ethiopian highlands: escarpment views, gelada monkeys and a night under the stars with a fully supported trekking crew.

tours.name: Omo Valley Cultural Tour
tours.description: A guided journey through the Omo Valley visiting local communities and markets — one of Africa's most remarkable cultural regions.

tours.name: Maasai Mara Safari
tours.description: Chase the Big Five across the Mara with a driver-guide, tented camp nights and game drives at dawn and dusk.

tours.name: Diani Beach Getaway
tours.description: White sand, warm Indian Ocean water and palm trees — transfers, beach stay and a sunset dhow cruise included.

tours.name: Lake Nakuru Day Safari
tours.description: A full-day trip from Nairobi to Lake Nakuru National Park — flamingos, rhinos and lakeside game viewing, back by dinner.
